description: This file contains PHP unit tests for the I18NLanguageAPI class within the OrangeHRM project. It defines a test class 'I18NLanguageAPITest' that runs various test cases on the API endpoints such as getAll, getOne, update, delete, and some unimplemented methods for create and validation rules. The test cases use data providers and mock services to validate API behavior.

classes.name: I18NLanguageAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the I18NLanguageAPI endpoints such as getAll, getOne, update, delete, and related functionality. It uses data providers for parameterized testing and mocks required services to isolate API logic.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests the getAll endpoint of the API with various test case parameters.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetAll
methods.description: Provides test cases for the testGetAll method, sourcing data from a YAML file.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests the update endpoint of the API with different scenarios.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestUpdate
methods.description: Provides test cases for the testUpdate method.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests that create() method of the API throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Tests that getValidationRuleForCreate() method throws a not implemented exception.
